gameObject.description: Associated game object ID. The default value is transport game object.

rtpc.description: Either the ID (GUID), name, or Short ID of the real-time parameter control.

examples.description: Resets the value of "rtpc", using its name, to the default for "gameObject".
examples.title: Resetting an RTPC value using its name

examples.description: Resets the value of "rtpc", using its GUID, to the default for "gameObject".
examples.title: Resetting an RTPC value using its GUID
